method: Read-only public DOM observations from browser UI interactions; assertions validate these saved observations, not an independently driven browser test.
environment: Windows Chromium 154, DPR 1; CSS viewport overrides only; no physical-device or low-end throttling.

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/154.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

notes: Loopback production build with a test-only passive probe; no CPU or network throttling.
rAF cadence is a main-thread scheduling proxy, not measured GPU/rendered FPS.
Zero transfer size can indicate a cache hit or restricted timing information.
Probe module requests are excluded from the resource totals.
Navigation, LCP and CLS belong to the initial document, not each subsequently opened overlay.
The probe adds a rAF callback and publishes this hidden output once per second.
